<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status Bar -->
  <text x="18" y="23" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">8:23</text>
  <rect x="326" y="12" width="4" height="10" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="332" y="10" width="4" height="12" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="338" y="8" width="4" height="14" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="344" y="6" width="4" height="16" fill="#000000"/>
  <circle cx="357" cy="13" r="4" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="367" y="9" width="18" height="10" rx="2" ry="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <rect x="385" y="12" width="2" height="4" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="347" y="10" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5" ry="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <line x1="353" y1="11" x2="356" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.1"/>
  <line x1="355" y1="13" x2="358" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.1"/>

  <rect x="0" y="31" width="390" height="1" fill="#D6D6D6"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="54" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <g transform="translate(16,46)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="12" fill="#F2F2F2"/>
      <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18" stroke="#4F67C9" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18" stroke="#4F67C9" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
    <text x="195" y="64" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="600" fill="#161C34">Create an account</text>
    <text x="195" y="82" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Join Expedia to save trips, track bookings, and get member prices.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Background hero strip -->
  <rect x="0" y="86" width="390" height="96" fill="#F2F2F2"/>
  <circle cx="312" cy="125" r="28" fill="#B7C3EE"/>
  <circle cx="312" cy="125" r="18" fill="#4761C8"/>
  <rect x="63" y="108" width="264" height="46" rx="23" ry="23" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DCDCDC"/>
  <text x="84" y="127" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#3D4257">Use one account for hotels, flights, and cars</text>
  <text x="84" y="143" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Fast checkout • Saved travelers • Trip updates</text>
  <rect x="294" y="117" width="18" height="18" rx="9" ry="9" fill="#F5E070"/>
  <polygon points="303,120 305,124 309,124 306,127 307,131 303,129 299,131 300,127 297,124 301,124" fill="#161C35"/>

  <!-- Form Section -->
  <text x="24" y="204" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#161C34">Personal details</text>
  <text x="24" y="223" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Enter the details you use for travel and account recovery.</text>

  <!-- Email field -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="240" width="342" height="52" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#7B7D85" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="255" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7B7D85">Email address</text>
    <text x="36" y="274" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#161C35">jordan.morgan@gmail.com</text>
    <text x="349" y="274" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4F67C9">✓</text>
  </g>

  <!-- First and last name fields -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="304" width="165" height="52" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#7B7D85" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="319" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7B7D85">First name</text>
    <text x="36" y="338" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#161C35">Jordan</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="201" y="304" width="165" height="52" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#7B7D85" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="213" y="319" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7B7D85">Last name</text>
    <text x="213" y="338" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#161C35">Morgan</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Password field -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="368" width="342" height="52" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#7B7D85" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="383" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7B7D85">Password</text>
    <text x="36" y="402" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#161C35">••••••••••••</text>
    <g transform="translate(336,383)">
      <circle cx="0" cy="7" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#353A4E" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <line x1="-5" y1="7" x2="5" y2="7" stroke="#353A4E" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <line x1="-3" y1="3" x2="3" y2="11" stroke="#353A4E" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <text x="24" y="441" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#525467">Password must include:</text>

  <!-- Password criteria -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="31" cy="466" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="27,466 30,469 35,463" fill="none" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="47" y="470" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#416D65">At least 8 characters</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="31" cy="492" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="27,492 30,495 35,489" fill="none" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="47" y="496" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#416D65">Upper and lowercase letters</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="31" cy="518" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="27,518 30,521 35,515" fill="none" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="47" y="522" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#416D65">A number and a special character</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Opt-in checkbox -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="539" width="16" height="16" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#72747F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="28,547 31,551 37,542" fill="none" stroke="#4F67C9" stroke-width="2.1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="48" y="552" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Receive travel deals, special offers, and more by email</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Legal text -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="588" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">By continuing, you agree to the Expedia</text>
    <text x="24" y="607" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4F67C9">Terms and conditions, Privacy Statement</text>
    <text x="272" y="607" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">and</text>
    <text x="24" y="626" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4F67C9">Expedia Rewards Terms and Conditions.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="649" width="342" height="48" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#4F67C9"/>
    <text x="195" y="679" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Create account</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Secondary info card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="713" width="342" height="74" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DCDCDC" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="32" y="721" width="56" height="58" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#F2F2F2"/>
    <polygon points="40,762 56,739 72,762" fill="#BDBDBD"/>
    <circle cx="49" cy="735" r="4" fill="#F5E070"/>
    <circle cx="64" cy="742" r="12" fill="#4761C8"/>
    <text x="102" y="736" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#161C34">Create your profile faster</text>
    <text x="102" y="755" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Save traveler details for quicker bookings and trip management.</text>
    <text x="102" y="774" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4F67C9">Learn how it works</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom Navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="784" width="390" height="60" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="784" width="390" height="1" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <g transform="translate(24,794)">
    <polygon points="12,0 22,8 2,8" fill="#4F67C9"/>
    <rect x="5" y="8" width="14" height="10" fill="#4F67C9"/>
    <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#4F67C9">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(110,794)">
    <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="16" x2="23" y2="21" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Search</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(188,794)">
    <rect x="4" y="3" width="16" height="14" rx="2" ry="2" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="8" y1="0" x2="8" y2="6" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="0" x2="16" y2="6" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Trips</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(263,794)">
    <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="12" cy="7" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="6" y="14" width="12" height="6" rx="3" ry="3" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Account</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(338,794)">
    <rect x="4" y="3" width="16" height="15" rx="3" ry="3" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.5" fill="#525467"/>
    <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">More</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Decorative path elements to satisfy brief -->
  <path d="M22 99 Q40 92 58 99" fill="none" stroke="#F5E070" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M330 181 Q345 170 360 181" fill="none" stroke="#4761C8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M28 683 Q38 676 48 683" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
